# Radix terminology popover

@radix-ui/react-popover 1.3.1 is used unmodified for rich terminology help.
Exact npm tarball sources and integrity hashes are in package-lock.json. LICENSES.txt preserves installed dependency license bytes with package headers. provenance.json identifies checksums and sources. React/React DOM are existing application dependencies.

react-remove-scroll-bar 2.3.8 omits LICENSE from its npm package. Its upstream MIT LICENSE was retrieved through the immutable Git blob recorded in provenance.json; this is an upstream license supplement, not a claim that the npm package contained it.

@axe-core/playwright 4.14.0 is development-only tooling and is not bundled into the renderer.
Official references: https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/popover and https://playwright.dev/docs/accessibility-testing

The aggregate preserves upstream line endings (including CRLF) and is marked `-text` in .gitattributes. Package headers and the final end marker are local separators.
